name: wordamix
description: Wordamix word game (web + Android via Capacitor)

scripts.test: node tests/engine.test.js && node tests/multiplayer.test.js && node tests/difficulty.test.js && node tests/multiplayer-difficulty.test.js
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
